text:
lina: quick UX pulse — when policies have many rules the rail becomes hard to parse. thinking about two small changes: a compact density toggle + inline conflict resolver.

ben: compact toggle sounds good. keep name + status visible, hide long descriptions, and show tiny icon chips for region/model/action. hover/focus expands details.

claire: inline conflict resolver = yes. currently simulator only shows a toast for priority ties which is easy to miss. propose a small inline badge 'priority tie' that opens a micro-resolver with two quick actions: bump priority or add guard.

lina: micro-resolver should be keyboard-first and optimistic (apply UI change while server confirms). also add aria-live announcements: 'Priority tie on Rule X' and after fix 'Rule X moved to position Y'.

tom: dev note: prefer transform animations for reorders, but respect prefers-reduced-motion. micro-resolver should be portal'd to avoid layout thrash and lazy-load heavy pieces.

claire: also preview idea: tiny coverage sparkline per rule (low-contrast) so users can see which rules actually fired. hover shows counts; include ARIA summary for screen readers.

preview-bot: preview-sim: density toggle + inline-badge + sparklines landed on staging. run `preview-sim --policy 555 --samples 300` to view.

ben: follow-ups: lina to mock compact toggle + micro-resolver, claire to write accessible announcement strings, tom to wire optimistic patch and portal. aiming for internal review next Wed. :thumbsup:

lina: will do — thanks!
